## Objective
Replace allocator-only P versus P+E sleeve arithmetic with a single joint portfolio execution and accounting path under one capital and risk budget.

## Owning authority
- D-153 portfolio contribution requirements.
- D-116 shared capital and cashflow semantics.
- docs/issues/ISSUE_164_CAPITAL_CONSTRAINED_USDM_SIMULATOR.md
- Related existing issue #325.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
allocator_mix explicitly discloses that it is allocator-level and not joint engine execution. Incumbent and challenger sleeves are mathematically mixed after separate return series; shared order netting, contention, margin, heat, and rejected orders are not represented in the economic comparison.

## Required end state
R1 — Run P and P+E under the same declared capital, allocation, concurrency, margin, heat, and fee rules.
R2 — Net opposing orders and account for rejected/unfilled orders in the shared ledger.
R3 — Report incremental portfolio return, risk, turnover, drawdown, and cost from the same joint account.
R4 — Prove the comparison isolates the declared component change.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/portfolio_backtest.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/portfolio_equity.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/economics/allocation.py
v8-next/tests/test_portfolio_benchmark.py
v8-next/tests/test_joint_portfolio_execution.py (new)

## Verification gates
Test shared-wallet conservation, overlapping instruments, opposing order netting, max concurrency, margin/heat contention, rejected orders, equal-budget P/P+E reruns, and deterministic incremental attribution.

## Required evidence artifacts
Joint P and P+E manifests; order/netting ledger; account snapshots; per-component attribution; capital conservation receipt; incremental portfolio report.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No strategy optimization, no independent-wallet summation labeled as portfolio return, no scalar readiness score, and no economic claim from a positive incremental result alone.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Capital denominator matches wallet topology. Authority: #325/D-153.
R2 — P+E is a counterfactual joint account, not a sum of standalone P&Ls.
R3 — Allocation and execution are distinct but reconciled.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse portfolio tape alignment, Nautilus account/position state, allocation/risk policies, campaign identities, and cashflow reconciliation.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: total capital is conserved across sleeves and cash.
I2: P and P+E use identical data, fees, horizon, and total risk budget.
I3: incremental result equals joint P+E net minus joint P net under declared estimand.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Ambiguous capital topology -> OPEN_PIN/DATA_BLOCKED.
Non-conserving account -> BLOCKED.
Unpaired orders -> EXECUTION_UNPROVEN.
Positive but uncertified result -> NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 15. Dependency Map
common tape -> P joint account / P+E joint account -> shared execution -> cashflow/equity -> incremental portfolio receipt.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #325. The v8-next implementation is explicitly marked allocator-level rather than joint engine execution.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
